title: The Marn Homestead
description: Professor Aris Thorne, a historian fascinated by the Marn legacy, wants to investigate the abandoned Marn Homestead. It's one of the most significant historical sites on Gravenmoor—the place where Dav Marn grew up. The local authorities won't allow official exploration, but if someone were to investigate independently, the professor would pay well for any historical artifacts or information found.
shortDescription: Investigate the Marn Homestead for historical artifacts

objectives.description: Speak with Professor Aris Thorne about the Marn Homestead
Investigate the homestead for historical artifacts
Return the datapad to Professor Thorne
